description: NaHfGaP₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.74 Å. Hf is bonded to six O atoms to form HfO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Hf-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.07 Å. Ga is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted GaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.22 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-40°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.55 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-35°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.56 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-35°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.51 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ga and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Hf, and one P atom.
